## Updating an answer

Edit `docs/uncertainties.json`, retaining the ID and qualified legacy references. Record the evidence and resulting model/disposition; mark an item resolved only when its specific question is answered or its implementation gap is closed. Regenerate with `python3 tools/forever_bench/uncertainties.py`.

Old T50, T51 and T52 labels were reused for different topics. The qualified aliases below preserve those references without conflating their answers. Private chat and identifying logs stay local.

## Inventory coverage

- Read the legacy in-game checks, dispositions, demo checklist, all eleven class/shared/consumable beta-pass reports, mechanics/history/MythicSim/weekly/latest-upstream reviews and tank report. Screened the other top-level source, gear, race, Tier, haste, spell-inventory and patch reports for unresolved claims.
- Reviewed 137 spell-manifest records selected for assumed, unreviewed or uncertainty-bearing notes. A manifest label is provenance, not proof of an active bug: stale labels such as Bloodthrill's borrowed ID and Quick Strikes being absent are superseded by current code.
- Screened 267 matching runtime comment lines. Unknown-enum names, implementation-language assumptions and unrelated Classic/legacy encounter TODOs are not gameplay questions. Real-item proc/guardian notes remain source-indexed conditional work under DATA-006 and DATA-007.
- Generated historical build tables are not independent sources. Their current caveats are represented by class entries; old result counts, paid-hit conventions and unreplayed research are not relabeled as current evidence.
- Private chat and combat-log identifiers remain local. Public source links and the committed review conclusions provide the shareable evidence trail. This is consolidation and current-code reconciliation, not a fresh in-game verification of every mechanic.

## Shared combat and resources

### CORE-001 — Boss attack tables

**Needs evidence · High priority · Later access**

**Question:** What are level-60 miss, dodge, parry, crit-suppression and glancing rules against level-63 targets?

**Current model:** Forever uses the explicit attack-table changes in the engine, with remaining inherited formulas. Demo columns and research checklists do not establish every boss case.

**Impact:** All melee, ranged and tank comparisons; hit caps and crit value.

**To close:** Capture a large controlled attack sample with known skill, hit, crit, target level and facing. Separate white, queued, special and ranged attacks; retain low-level checks as partial evidence.

**References:** [sim/core/attack.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/attack.go) · [sim/core/spell_result.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/spell_result.go) · [docs/check_dispositions.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/check_dispositions.md) · [https://github.com/magey/forever-warrior/issues/1](https://github.com/magey/forever-warrior/issues/1)

**Earlier references:** T01 / T06

### CORE-002 — Energy regeneration and haste

**Needs evidence · High priority · Level 20**

**Question:** Does general haste increase Energy regeneration, and do attack-speed-only effects leave it unchanged?

**Current model:** 10 Energy/sec integrated in 100-ms steps; general haste provisionally increases the rate. Slice and Dice, Berserking and attack-only enchants do not. The step size is not a measured server tick.

**Impact:** Feral and all Rogue builds; haste and resource value.

**To close:** Compare uncapped recovery over long matched windows with zero and known general haste, excluding spends, refunds and other energizes. The existing 1% sample is not precise enough to establish the effect. Test attack-speed-only effects separately.

**References:** [docs/energy_audit.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/energy_audit.md) · [docs/check_dispositions.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/check_dispositions.md) · [sim/core/energy.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/energy.go)

**Earlier references:** T15 (haste/cadence) / T35

### CORE-003 — Energy refunds on avoided attacks

**Needs evidence · High priority · Level 20**

**Question:** Which builders and finishers refund Energy on miss, dodge or parry, and what fraction of the paid cost returns?

**Current model:** Inherited 80% builder refunds; damaging finishers generally do not refund. Costs are charged before the outcome.

**Impact:** Feral and Rogue resource supply, especially before hit cap or when attacking from the front.

**To close:** Log resource values around isolated avoided builders and finishers at known costs. Record combo-point retention separately. Do not infer a universal refund from one ability.

**References:** [docs/energy_audit.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/energy_audit.md) · [sim/core/energy.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/energy.go) · [sim/rogue/eviscerate.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/rogue/eviscerate.go) · [sim/druid/ferocious_bite.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/druid/ferocious_bite.go)

**Earlier references:** T16 / H09

### CORE-004 — Spell GCD versus physical GCD

**Needs evidence · High priority · Level 20**

**Question:** Which speed effects shorten magical and physical GCDs, and what is the minimum?

**Current model:** The adopted WoWSims-style rule hastes magical GCDs with casting speed, retains fixed physical GCDs, and uses a one-second floor. Missing magical schools were corrected across the audited utility spells.

**Impact:** All rotations; especially instant Shaman spells and physical 1.5-second abilities.

**To close:** Measure repeated casts with known speed effects and client GCD categories. Compare magical instant spells against physical abilities and fixed one-second actions; include latency/error bounds.

**References:** [docs/speed_audit.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/speed_audit.md) · [docs/weekly_review.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/weekly_review.md) · [sim/core/cast.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/cast.go) · [sim/core/spell.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/spell.go)

**Earlier references:** T17 / T40 (GCD)

### CORE-005 — Channel speed sources

**Needs evidence · High priority · Level 20**

**Question:** Which general-haste effects compress channels, distinct from casting-speed-only effects?

**Current model:** Separate SpellHaste scales supported channels provisionally. Berserking speeds hardcasts but not Arcane Missiles; Missile Barrage has its own explicit tick period. No selected item supplies raw SpellHaste.

**Impact:** Mage, Priest and Warlock channels; hypothetical haste scaling.

**To close:** Time all ticks and completion under individually isolated general haste, casting speed and explicit channel modifiers. Existing Mage observations support the Berserking distinction, not a universal aura-65 rule.

**References:** [docs/speed_audit.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/speed_audit.md) · [docs/check_dispositions.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/check_dispositions.md) · [sim/mage/arcane_missiles.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/mage/arcane_missiles.go) · [sim/priest/mind_flay.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/priest/mind_flay.go)

### CORE-007 — Judgement of Wisdom trigger rules

**Needs evidence · High priority · Later access**

**Question:** Which events trigger Wisdom, at what probability and with what cooldown?

**Current model:** The level-60 return is 59 mana. The inherited event/proc model, including its 50% chance, remains provisional; self-hits are excluded.

**Impact:** Mana sustainability of melee Hunters, Paladins and other frequent attackers.

**To close:** Use a controlled, isolated Wisdom target; count eligible white, special, spell, periodic and proc events against mana returns. Repeat with fast attacks to identify an ICD.

### CORE-008 — Dynamic periodic damage boundaries

**Needs evidence · High priority · Level 20**

**Question:** Which damage components update during an existing DoT, and which cast-specific bonuses remain attached?

**Current model:** Forever periodic damage uses dynamic stats/modifiers under the adopted no-snapshot model, with explicit cast-specific effects and Ignite exclusions. Deep Wounds also reads current weapon/AP state.

**Impact:** All DoT builds; temporary buffs, weapon swaps and poison upkeep.

**To close:** Apply one DoT, change one stat or damage buff mid-duration without reapplying, and compare ticks. Test cast-only charge buffs separately from ordinary stats; distinguish a proc payload from an ordinary DoT.

### CORE-006 — Optional MP5-per-second interpretation

**Needs evidence · Medium priority · Level 20**

**Question:** Does a flat displayed MP5 point restore one mana per five seconds or per second?

**Current model:** Ordinary MP5/5 per second is the default. The explicit optional mode multiplies only the MP5 stat contribution by five; it is off in rankings.

**Impact:** Mana users if enabled; does not establish a current ranking error.

**To close:** Compare matched uncapped mana recovery with a known flat MP5 delta, both while spending mana and outside the five-second rule. Keep Spirit and direct returns constant; a tooltip or OOM result alone is insufficient.

**References:** [docs/mana_regeneration.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/mana_regeneration.md) · [sim/core/mana.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/mana.go)

**Earlier references:** T44

**Needs evidence · Medium priority · Level 20**

**Question:** Does the last Eureka charge benefit every tick of the consuming channel/DoT after the aura expires?

**Current model:** Charged casts preserve a tagged bonus; ordinary periodic stat updates remain separate. Cost reductions follow the engine's additive convention.

**Impact:** Gnome resource use and damage, particularly channels.

**To close:** Spend the last charge on a channel and a DoT, then compare all ticks with uncharged controls. Check simultaneous proc/cast completion and damage-free actions.

## Warrior

### WAR-001 — Level-60 outgoing rage normalization

**Needs evidence · High priority · Later access**

**Question:** Do the measured low-level speed-based rage rates persist at level 60?

**Current model:** Damage-independent rage: base weapon speed × 4.5 for two-handers, or × (4.5/1.3) for one-hand main hand. Crits/glances do not increase it; haste changes swing frequency, not rage per hit.

**Impact:** All Warrior damage, gear selection and rotation decisions.

**To close:** Collect unclipped resource deltas with known weapon speeds at higher levels, holding damage and haste independently variable. Existing level-8–20 logs support only that measured range.

**References:** [sim/core/rage.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/rage.go) · [docs/check_dispositions.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/check_dispositions.md) · [docs/flurry_review.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/flurry_review.md) · [https://github.com/tzcnt/forever-data/tree/main/raw-logs](https://github.com/tzcnt/forever-data/tree/main/raw-logs)

**Earlier references:** T02 (outgoing rates) / M06

### WAR-002 — Off-hand and extra-swing rage

**Needs evidence · High priority · Later access**

**Question:** What rage do off-hand, avoided and proc-generated swings award?

**Current model:** Half-rate off-hand before the sourced Dual Wield Specialization multiplier; avoided autos award none. This is not a measured complete level-60 Fury rule.

**Impact:** Fury, Windfury and weapon-proc value.

**To close:** Separate MH/OH and extra attacks in an uncapped resource log; isolate talent rank, avoidance outcome and proc source. Keep ordinary-hit measurements separate.

**References:** [sim/core/rage.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/rage.go) · [docs/check_dispositions.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/check_dispositions.md)

### WAR-003 — Incoming rage and mitigation

**Needs evidence · High priority · Level 20**

**Question:** Does unmitigated damage × 10 / maximum health explain incoming rage at all armor/health values?

**Current model:** That formula is used for Forever Warriors. The low-level doubled low-armor cluster and higher-level behavior remain unexplained; other classes retain their separate rules.

**Impact:** Protection rotation, self-damage resource gains and tank stat trade-offs.

**To close:** Repeat matched incoming hits at several armor and maximum-health values; account for concurrent outgoing swings and resource caps. Extend the sample to level 60 later.

### WAR-006 — Flurry amount and charge events

**Needs evidence · High priority · Later access**

**Question:** Which events proc, refresh and spend Flurry, and does the talent curve or triggered aura determine speed?

**Current model:** 5–25% melee speed; three shared charges. White-tagged events, including avoided swings and queued replacements, consume charges without a 500-ms gate. Melee crits refill after consumption. Each Cleave target may consume a charge.

**Impact:** All Flurry builds, especially dual wield and cleave.

**To close:** Record aura stacks and swing timestamps around crits, avoided MH/OH attacks, simultaneous swings and multi-target Cleave. Compare ranks. Issue 12 is a research plan, not a measured answer.

## Paladin

### PAL-001 — Seal of Righteousness spell-power formula

**Needs evidence · High priority · Level 20**

**Question:** Should the proc add SP once or twice, and is the retained two-hand 1.1 factor real in Forever?

**Current model:** Retains the double-add formula and two-hand factor inherited from older testing. A client coefficient alone does not validate the full formula.

**Impact:** Current rank-2 Smite/Lightning Bolt, lower-rank Paladin choices and conditional Frostfire research.

**To close:** Measure low and high ranks at the same level across two SP totals; repeat above the learned level. Separate coefficients, base growth and resource costs.

**References:** [docs/build_updates.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/build_updates.md) · [docs/check_dispositions.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/check_dispositions.md)

### DATA-002 — Projected gear budget and stat prices

**Current model:** Hypothetical level-65 items use sourced quantity/armor/weapon tables but assumed nonlinear allocation budgets and special-stat prices. Equal cost is not equal DPS, and Intellect is not generic SP.

**Impact:** All cross-class rankings and gear scaling; tank defensive coverage must not be fabricated.

**To close:** Keep assumptions and per-item proofs visible; replace prices/templates only with supported crafted/PvP comparisons or an explicit scenario decision. Validate selected totals, not only item level.

## Encounters and simulator coverage

### SCEN-001 — Tank boss damage and external healing

**Model assumption · High priority · Model decision**

**Question:** What incoming damage and healing should define a representative tank comparison?

**Current model:** Explicit stress scenarios: one 300-second boss or three 90-second attackers with fixed swing/AP/armor/healing settings. These are not observed raid bosses or healer behavior.

**Impact:** Tank DPS, rage, mana, threat and death rates; cannot be silently equated with un-attacked DPS rows.

**To close:** Publish the exact assumptions and preserve matched controls; add measured encounters when available. Evaluate survival and least-target threat alongside DPS, not summed TPS alone.

**References:** [docs/tank_benchmark.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/tank_benchmark.md) · [tools/forever_tanks/main.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/tools/forever_tanks/main.go)

### SCEN-003 — Tank target selection and threat coverage

**Implementation gap · High priority · Sources / code**

**Question:** Can a tank maintain threat on the weakest-covered enemy rather than repeatedly attacking the first?

**Current model:** Existing Warrior multi-target presets remain single-target focused; summed TPS masks very low threat on an add. No lowest-threat target selector is provided.

**Impact:** First-class AoE tank support and meaningful optimization.

**To close:** Implement explicit target cycling/selection that respects target-local debuffs and proc state; validate per-target threat and maintenance, not just aggregate DPS.

**References:** [docs/tank_benchmark.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/tank_benchmark.md) · [proto/apl.proto](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/proto/apl.proto) · [sim/core/apl_helpers.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/core/apl_helpers.go)

### SCEN-004 — Tank gear search and exact matrix profiles

**Implementation gap · High priority · Sources / code**

**Question:** Are all tank races using validated auto-selected gear and full reproducible ranking defaults?

**Current model:** Three tank routes and 17 race smoke checks exist, but current gear is a starting setup, not a defensively constrained coordinate search; tanks are absent from the main matrix.

**Impact:** Fair tank comparisons and reproducible UI defaults.

**To close:** Integrate 17 exact profiles, select legal normalized gear/enchants and validate talent/APL choices against survival/threat controls. Publish paired sensitivities and mark tank scenarios distinctly.

**References:** [docs/tank_benchmark.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/tank_benchmark.md) · [tools/forever_tanks/main.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/tools/forever_tanks/main.go) · [tools/forever_bench/build_display.py](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/tools/forever_bench/build_display.py)

### SCEN-002 — Non-tank external healing abstraction

**Model assumption · Medium priority · Model decision**

**Question:** How should health costs constrain Life Tap, Death and self-damaging consumables in DPS scenarios?

**Current model:** Self-damage is excluded from enemy DPS. Non-tanking resource use retains its external-healing abstraction rather than a finite healer budget; tank requests pay real health costs.

**Impact:** Resource sustainability and practical healer burden.

**To close:** Keep damage/resource accounting separate; add an explicit constrained-healing scenario if needed instead of interpreting DPS-only output as survival validation.

**References:** [sim/warlock/lifetap.go](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/sim/warlock/lifetap.go) · [docs/upstream_elliot_review.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/upstream_elliot_review.md) · [docs/forever-70009.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/forever-70009.md)

### SCEN-005 — General absorb-pool and shielding threat

**Implementation gap · Medium priority · Sources / code**

**Question:** Do generic shields consume finite incoming damage and generate correct threat?

**Current model:** The generic Shield helper records shielding without a full pool-consumption model or shielding threat. Templar's Bulwark has its own finite pool and is no longer the old 99% reduction shortcut.

**Impact:** Priest/healing shields and future Seal of Fury integration; not a reason to revert correct Bulwark behavior.

**To close:** Implement a reusable absorption/expiry/ordering model with sourced threat rules and separate generated-versus-effective shielding metrics.

**Current model:** Blood Pact's level-60 value and party scope are fixed, but the automatic provider remains static rather than a full dynamic pet-lifecycle model.

**Impact:** AoE, solo and alternate target types, not proof of a current five-minute gain.

**To close:** Use the spell inventory to implement sourced relevant actions and target restrictions. Add encounter conditions before evaluating reactive damage; do not enable NPC/rune leftovers.

### SCEN-010 — Forced Tier 1 and synthetic stat scaling

**Model assumption · Medium priority · Model decision**

**Current model:** Full role Tier 1 is forced independently of equipment. Stat/weapon scaling holds enchants/procs/talents/APLs fixed; amplification is finite-range curvature, not proof of exponential growth or future loot.

## Resolved questions and superseded claims

### DONE-001 — Healing is not inferred spell damage

**Resolved · High priority · Sources / code**

**Question:** Are pure healing effects accidentally converted to spell damage?

**Current model:** The generic one-third fallback is removed. Sourced hybrid healing/damage effects are imported separately, including enchants.

**Impact:** Historical gear/enchant misvaluation; current projected catalogs and real-effect imports retain explicit values.

**To close:** Closed by source-backed import and enchant corrections. Reopen only for a specific contradictory item/effect, not by assuming all healing has SP.

**References:** [docs/forever_gear_data.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/forever_gear_data.md) · [docs/mechanics_review.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/mechanics_review.md)

**Earlier references:** T22 / H02

### DONE-002 — Hot Streak and Clearcasting consumption

**Resolved · High priority · Sources / code**

**Question:** Can the old persistent proc buffs still provide repeated accelerated/free casts?

**Current model:** Completed Pyroblast consumes Hot Streak; eligible paid damage casts consume Clearcasting using underlying cost, not the discounted zero.

**Impact:** Historical Mage resource/damage error fixed; edge timing has separate active entries.

**To close:** Closed with client charge/cost checks and regressions; retain MAG-004/MAG-005 for unresolved ordering only.

**References:** [docs/history_review.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/history_review.md) · [docs/mechanics_review.md](https://github.com/gunba/wow-forever-sim/blob/forever/docs/mechanics_review.md)

### DONE-003 — Death, Early Demise and Penance timing

### DONE-010 — Seal of Command SP placement comparison

**Resolved · Medium priority · Sources / code**

**Question:** Does this engine omit the 70% multiplier on personal SP that upstream added?

**Current model:** No: proc DamageMultiplier is 0.7 × Improved Seals × weapon specialization, with BonusCoefficient 0.29. Personal SP passes through that multiplier; target Holy bonus is applied separately afterward.

**Impact:** A recent review overstated the difference by comparing field placement rather than final math. Righteousness remains genuinely unresolved.

**To close:** Closed the implementation-difference claim by tracing CalcDamage. Further in-game seal trigger/scaling evidence can be tracked without applying the 70% twice.
